connectorUiConfig.title: DarkStrata Ghost (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The DarkStrata Ghost data connector ingests ghost (honeytoken) events from the DarkStrata Ghost event feed into Microsoft Sentinel. A ghost is a decoy identity that exists only to be stolen: when DarkStrata finds one in a stealer log, breach or combolist, a `ghost.seen` event is raised. `ghost.deployed` and `ghost.retired` events record the ghost lifecycle, and an unexpected `ghost.retired` is a tamper alarm.

The connector polls `GET /v1/ghosts/events` every 5 minutes, follows the feed cursor so no event is skipped or duplicated, and writes typed rows to the `DarkStrataGhostEvents_CL` table.

sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where EventType == "ghost.seen" and not(IsTest)
| project TimeGenerated, Kind, Severity, GhostLabel, GhostEmail, MatchSource, CorpusName, ConsoleUrl
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

{{graphQueriesTableName}}
| where EventType == "ghost.retired"
| project TimeGenerated, GhostLabel, RetiredByName, RetiredReason, ConsoleUrl
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: DarkStrata API key
customs.description: A DarkStrata API key with the `ghost:read` permission (default API keys have it). Create one in the DarkStrata console (app.darkstrata.io).

instructionSteps.title: Connect DarkStrata Ghost to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Enter your DarkStrata API key and select **Connect**. The first poll replays the last 30 days of ghost events; after that only new events are fetched. Events appear about a minute after DarkStrata records them.
